title: Healthcare debt collections agency cuts call wrap time in half with proNotes -
summary: An Illinois healthcare and retail collections agency used proNotes to cut wrap time 50% within two weeks and save $8,000 per agent a year.
body_markdown:
A leading Illinois-based agency focused on healthcare and retail receivables wanted to minimize after-call work and increase productive time on calls. Agents could then work more accounts and focus on borrowers without distraction.


- **50%** reduction in wrap time
- **20%** increase in in-call time
- **$8,000** annual savings per agent


## The challenge


The agency struggled to give agents more time with borrowers and less time on post-call wrap-up. Letting agents focus on borrowers instead of note-taking would improve customer satisfaction, and automating after-call work would relieve agent stress and improve efficiency.


## The solution


The agency adopted proNotes. Prodigal's speech and natural language processing AI summarizes each conversation into succinct notes in real time, replacing manual notes taken during wrap-up. The note is ready as soon as the call ends, and collectors can review and edit it before submitting.


## The results


proNotes delivered a major productivity boost. Most agents saw wrap time fall by 50% within two weeks, which translated to a 20% increase in in-call time across the board.


> “Every agency wants to maximize the amount of time their agents are spending talking to right party contacts, and proNotes does exactly that. I was shocked when I saw how quickly our wrap times improved. proNotes is a must-have for collectors of all experience levels.”
> Chief Information Officer
